name: espanso
description: Manage Espanso text expander snippets, matches, packages, and macOS text automation config.

interface.longDescription: Use Espanso to inspect and update local text-expander configuration. The skill treats Espanso config as live machine state: inspect first, show the intended change, back up edited files, and require confirmation before writing, installing packages, restarting services, or adding shell/script expansions.
defaultPrompt: Use espanso to add this text expansion
Review my Espanso matches for this trigger
Help debug why this Espanso snippet is not expanding
